FRENCH — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #3
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: FRENCH
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which food is good for your health? (1 mark)
   A. les bonbons
   B. l'eau
   C. les frites
   D. les chips

2. Which is the correct spelling of the French word for 'brother'? (1 mark)
   A. frère
   B. frere
   C. frére
   D. frèe

3. What does 'Joyeux anniversaire !' mean? (1 mark)
   A. Thank you very much!
   B. There is a cake and there are balloons.
   C. It is the first of January.
   D. Happy birthday!

4. Which is the correct spelling of the French word for 'mother'? (1 mark)
   A. mére
   B. mere
   C. mère
   D. mèe

5. Which sentence is correct for one orange? (1 mark)
   A. C'est une orange.
   B. C'est des oranges.
   C. Ce sont une orange.
   D. Ce sont un orange.

6. Which little word goes with 'pain' (the bread)? (1 mark)
   A. les
   B. la
   C. l'
   D. le

7. How do you say 'the sun' in French? (1 mark)
   A. le soleil
   B. une inondation
   C. la pluie
   D. le nuage

8. Choose the correct French word to complete: ______, je m'appelle Amina. (1 mark)
   A. Bonne nuit
   B. Bonjour
   C. Au revoir
   D. Merci

9. What does 'C'est le premier janvier.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. There is a cake and there are balloons.
   B. It is the first of January.
   C. Thank you very much!
   D. Here is a present for you.

10. What number is 'vingt et un' in French? (1 mark)
   A. 30
   B. 19
   C. 25
   D. 21

11. What does 'à droite' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. straight ahead
   B. near
   C. to the right
   D. to the left

12. Read: Dans le salon, il y a un canapé et une télé. Le tapis est devant le canapé. Le chat est sous la table. Question: What is in the living room? (1 mark)
   A. a sofa and a TV
   B. a garden
   C. a shower
   D. a bed and a fridge

13. Fill in: Le chat est ______ le lit et la porte. (between) (1 mark)
   A. sur
   B. sous
   C. entre
   D. dans

14. How do you say 'beans' in French? (1 mark)
   A. les haricots
   B. la mangue
   C. le riz
   D. les frites

15. How do you say 'My sister is called Njeri.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Mon frère s'appelle Kamau.
   B. C'est ma sœur.
   C. Ma sœur s'appelle Njeri.
   D. Ma mère s'appelle Grace.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Translate into French: 'The TV is in the living room.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

17. Write three sentences in French with J'ai and a number about your body. (3 marks) (3 marks)

18. Write the French words for: near, the rug, the key (3 marks) (3 marks)

19. Translate into French: 'Here is my house.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

20. Translate into French: 'I have two eyes.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

21. Translate into English: 'Voici ma grand-mère.' (2 marks) (2 marks)
pages.answers:
FRENCH — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #3 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. B — l'eau
   Water is good for your health.

2. A — frère
   The correct spelling is frère, with its accents.

3. D — Happy birthday!
   Joyeux anniversaire ! means Happy birthday!

4. C — mère
   The correct spelling is mère, with its accents.

5. A — C'est une orange.
   One feminine thing: C'est une ...

6. D — le
   pain is masculine, so we say le pain.

7. A — le soleil
   the sun in French is le soleil.

8. B — Bonjour
   Bonjour is a greeting, and it fits before introducing yourself.

9. B — It is the first of January.
   C'est le premier janvier. means It is the first of January.

10. D — 21
   vingt et un means 21.

11. C — to the right
   à droite means to the right.

12. A — a sofa and a TV
   Un canapé et une télé.

13. C — entre
   Entre means between.

14. A — les haricots
   beans in French is les haricots.

15. C — Ma sœur s'appelle Njeri.
   My sister is called Njeri. in French is Ma sœur s'appelle Njeri.

SECTION B
----
16. (3 marks)
   Answer: La télé est dans le salon.
   Working / marking points: Award marks for correct words, articles, accents and punctuation: 3 marks in total.

17. (3 marks)
   Answer: J'ai deux mains. J'ai dix doigts. J'ai deux pieds.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct sentence.

18. (3 marks)
   Answer: près de, le tapis, la clé
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct word with its accents and le or la.

19. (2 marks)
   Answer: Voici ma maison.
   Working / marking points: Award marks for correct words, articles, accents and punctuation: 2 marks in total.

20. (2 marks)
   Answer: J'ai deux yeux.
   Working / marking points: Award marks for correct words, articles, accents and punctuation: 2 marks in total.

21. (2 marks)
   Answer: Here is my grandmother.
   Working / marking points: Award marks for each correct part of the meaning: 2 marks in total.
